svg.aria-label: Gautam Khosla. Ascend higher. I build software you can check instead of trust. A layered paper map floats on the page: the mountain is his real public GitHub contributions, 1 metre each, so the summit stands at 1,399 m on 10 NOV 2026. The route climbs from base camp (26 JUL 2026) through a camp at each release, and from the summit a trajectory leaves the map.
